title: Understanding Model Variance
text: Model variance refers to how much the model's predictions change when it is trained on different subsets of the data. If the variance stays the same, it means the model's predictions are consistent across different data samples.

title: Impact of Decreased Bias
text: When model bias decreases, it means the model is better at capturing the underlying patterns in the data. This can lead to more accurate predictions.

title: Possible Outcomes of Decreased Bias
text: Consider what happens when bias decreases but variance remains the same. Could this affect the model's overall performance?
